name: LaRue v. DeWolff, Boberg & Associates, Inc.
summary: The Supreme Court held that ERISA Section 502(a)(2) authorizes individual 401(k) plan participants to sue for losses to their own accounts caused by a fiduciary breach, not just losses affecting the plan as a whole.
significance: Confirmed that individual plan participants can bring ERISA fiduciary breach claims to recover losses to their individual accounts in defined contribution plans like 401(k)s, establishing the right to sue that petitioners exercise here.
